column2: [Root.GetMourningBehavior]. Yet life goes on, and a letter from [the_protector_general.GetTitledFirstName] was received today. It expresses the condolences of the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap], assuring that the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] mourns with us.

A servant informs me that we have a visitor. Cursing the early hour, I roll out of bed and make my way to the main hall. The envoy bows deeply, stating that the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] wishes to express [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] condolences, by gifting me something that used to belong to my [FromFrom.GetRootRelation], [FromFrom.GetTitledName].

My servants have finished cleaning out my [FromFrom.GetRootRelation]'s chambers and I have come to take a final look. [Root.GetMourningBehavior]. 'My [Root.GetLordLady], we found this', one of the servants says, interrupting my thoughts and handing me a small book.

One morning I awake to find that an envoy from the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] has arrived and wishes to speak with me. "Greetings to the [GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [Root.GetTitledFirstName]. [GetCathayanLetterBlessing]. I am [From.GetFullName] and I come bearing treasures from Grand Cathay to barter and trade on behalf of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName]. Does this matter interest you?"

One morning I awake to find that [From.GetFullName], the Cathayan trader I was gifted by the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle], wishes to speak with me. "Greetings to the [GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [Root.GetTitledFirstName]. [GetCathayanLetterBlessing]. I have recently been sent some treasures from my homeland and have been granted permission to barter and trade on behalf of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName]. Does this matter interest you?"

[FromFrom.GetFullName] nods [FromFrom.GetHerHis] head and bows. "The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] will be most pleased with this, you truly are a [GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [Root.GetTitle]!" As [FromFrom.GetFullName] departs I move to inspect my newly acquired [FromFrom.Culture.GetName] treasure.

Come the evening everything proceeds exactly as I intended. The food is good, the drinks are flowing and [FromFrom.GetFullName] is smiling the entire night. The following morning, as [FromFrom.GetFullName] departs, [FromFrom.GetSheHe] points to a chest which contains a [FromFrom.Culture.GetName] treasure that [FromFrom.GetSheHe] wishes for me to have as thanks for the feast and for being such a gracious host.

Come the evening things do not go as I planned. The food and drink is not to [FromFrom.GetFullName]'s taste and [FromFrom.GetSheHe] is obviously not enjoying [FromFrom.GetHerselfHimself]. The following morning [FromFrom.GetFullName] departs, likely to not speak highly of me to the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle]. There will be no foreign treasures for me today...

After [cathayan_guest.GetFullName]'s departure I was informed about a note in my room attached to a chest, it reads "To the [GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [Root.GetTitle], I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at your court and wanted to leave you a token of appreciation on behalf of myself and the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle]. I hope it pleases you."
'The world is worse off without your [FromFrom.GetRootRelation] in it'.
You read the words carefully, taking them to heart, and order that a letter of thanks be sent back.\n
I humbly accept the gift from the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle].
§Y[cathayan_artifact.GetName]§! is added to your Treasury.\nIt will always remind you of your [FromFrom.GetRootRelation].\n
Wait – this must have belonged to [FromFrom.GetHerHim]...!
§Y[cathayan_artifact.GetName]§! is added to your Treasury.\n
The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] is always in need of more eunuchs! Take [cathayan_envoy_eunuch_target.GetTitledFirstName].
I have always considered myself a [Root.GetManWoman] of refined taste!
You decide to still take comfort in the gesture.\n
I think I am done dwelling on the past.
I cannot bear to read it...!
Please, take it away – it would only serve as a reminder of [FromFrom.GetHerHis] death.
You decide to focus on other things in life instead.\n
Do you take me for a sentimental fool?
You tell the servants to get rid of the item.\n
[cathayan_envoy_concubine_target.GetTitledFirstName] will make an excellent concubine for the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle].
What a magnificent trinket, I shall certainly put it to good use!
We shall send plenty of gold for you to return with!
It is not my fault [FromFrom.GetSheHe] is so picky!
We will have a feast in [From.GetHerHis] honor! But what will my subjects think?
Your baubles and trinkets are of no importance here.
